meta.title: Bike stolen? File a quick report — Velopass
meta.description: Step-by-step after a bike theft: report your bike in your Velopass, file online with the police, and activate the Velopass Community.

hero.title: File a quick report. Velopass helps you.
hero.lead: A police report needs exact bike details — details you no longer have at hand when your bike is gone. Unless you have Velopass.

argument.title: Everything the police needs is in your Velopass
rows: Already entered when you reported it in Velopass

step1.title: Step 1 — Report your bike as missing
step1.body: Log in to your Velopass account and go to **'My bike'**. Click **'Report as missing'**. Your bike's status changes to REPORTED — the Velopass Community is activated immediately.
step1.badge_note: Anyone scanning your Frame-ID sees that your bike is being looked for and can give you an anonymous heads-up.

step2.title: Step 2 — File an online report with the police
step2.lead: Pick your country for the step-by-step.

BE.intro: In Belgium you file an online report via Police-on-web. That saves you a trip to the police station.

checklist.text: Your ID card (eID) or the itsme app
Brand, model, colour and type of bike
Exact location, date and time of the theft
checklist.velopass: Already entered when you reported it in Velopass

steps.title: Go to police-on-web.be
steps.body: [www.police-on-web.be](https://www.police-on-web.be)

steps.title: Start a new report
steps.body: Click **'Start a new report'** and pick **'Bike theft'**.

steps.title: Sign in via CSAM
steps.body: Identify yourself with your eID card reader or the itsme app.

steps.title: Fill in the form
steps.body:
• Personal details as owner/reporter
• Facts: where and when was it stolen?
• Object: every detail of the bike (the more detail, the higher the chance of recovery)
steps.tip: Open your Velopass to have every bike detail at hand in one glance.

steps.title: Review and submit
steps.body: Check the details and click **Submit**.

BE.after_body: You receive a case number and a confirmation. The official record (PV) is drawn up by the local police zone. Got bike insurance? Forward the PV number to your insurer to start your claim.
BE.found_body: Stolen bikes are often abandoned somewhere. Check [www.gevondenfietsen.be](https://www.gevondenfietsen.be) regularly — your bike may turn up there.

NL.intro: In the Netherlands you file an online report via politie.nl. You need a DigiD for this.
NL.check_first_body: Has your bike maybe been moved by the city? Bikes parked illegally are sometimes taken to a depot. Check this before filing a report.

checklist.text: Brand, model, colour and type of bike
The frame number (usually under the bottom bracket or on the front of the frame)
Exact location, date and time of the theft
checklist.velopass: Already entered when you reported it in Velopass

NL.conditions_intro: Online filing via politie.nl is possible if:
conditions: The bike was not stolen from a home, shed or garage
The theft was less than one year ago
NL.conditions_note: Doesn't apply? Call 0900-8844 or file in person at a police station.

steps.title: Go to politie.nl
steps.body: [www.politie.nl/aangifte](https://www.politie.nl/aangifte-of-melding-doen/aangifte-van-diefstal-fiets.html)

steps.title: Pick bike theft
steps.body: Choose **'Aangifte doen van fietsdiefstal'**.

steps.title: Sign in with DigiD
steps.body: Sign in with your DigiD via the CSAM portal.

steps.title: Fill in the form
steps.body:
• Personal details as owner/reporter
• Facts: where and when was it stolen? Was the bike locked?
• Object: every detail of the bike — the more detail, the higher the chance of recovery
steps.tip: Open your Velopass to have every bike detail at hand — including the location you entered when reporting it. Copy that straight into the form.

steps.title: Review and submit
steps.body: Check the details and submit the report.

NL.after_body: You receive a confirmation with a case number. Keep it safe — you'll need it for your insurance. Your bike is automatically added to the RDW bike theft register and to StopHeling, so traders can check whether a bike is stolen. Got bike insurance? Report the theft directly to your insurer and include the case number.
NL.tip1_body: Stolen bikes are often abandoned somewhere. Check [www.gevondenfietsen.be](https://www.gevondenfietsen.be) regularly.
NL.tip2_body: Stolen bikes sometimes appear on second-hand platforms within days. Recognise your bike? Never confront the seller yourself — call the police on 0900-8844.

FR.fnuci_title: Velopass is a recognised operator of the French national bike register
FR.fnuci_body_1: As a French resident, your Velopass registration is automatically linked to the **FNUCI** — the *Fichier National Unique des Cycles Identifiés*. This is the official state register that police and gendarmerie use when tracking stolen bikes.
FR.fnuci_body_2: Concretely: as soon as you report your bike as stolen in Velopass, the status in the FNUCI is updated automatically. The police see it instantly.

flow_steps.title: You report in Velopass
flow_steps.body: You change your bike's status to REPORTED in your Velopass account.

flow_steps.title: FNUCI is updated
flow_steps.body: Velopass forwards the status change to the FNUCI. Police and gendarmerie have access to this register.

flow_steps.title: Police identify your bike
flow_steps.body: Is your bike found? The officer scans the Velopass code and immediately sees that it's stolen — and who the owner is.

FR.code_note: **Your Velopass code IS your FNUCI identifier.** This is the 10-digit number the police need for the official *plainte*. You'll find it in your Velopass account.
FR.ma_intro: File your report online via Ma Sécurité. Your Velopass code is the *identifiant unique* the form asks for — already in your Velopass.
FR.home_already_body: Belgian and Dutch insurers almost always require a French police report. Start the report as quickly as possible via Ma Sécurité, even if you're already home.

checklist.note: Without FranceConnect: in-person appointment required at a French police station or gendarmerie

checklist.text: Brand, model, colour and type of bike
Exact French location, date and time
checklist.velopass: Already entered when you reported it in Velopass — as a tourist you often can't recall the exact address later

FR.method1_body: Do you live in France or have a French government account? Then you file the full report online and receive the official *procès-verbal* by email.
FR.method2_body: Fill in the form online and then book an appointment at a French police station (*commissariat de police*) or gendarmerie. Already back home? Use the 24/7 chat on Ma Sécurité to ask about alternatives.

steps.title: Go to Ma Sécurité
steps.body:
[plainte-en-ligne.masecurite.interieur.gouv.fr](https://plainte-en-ligne.masecurite.interieur.gouv.fr/)
Switch to the English version in the top right.

steps.title: Pick 'Vol' (Theft)
steps.body: Select **'Vol'** as the type of offence.

steps.title: Sign in via FranceConnect or as a guest
steps.body: With FranceConnect everything runs fully online. Without FranceConnect you can continue as a guest.

steps.title: Fill in the form
steps.body:
• Identifiant unique: your Velopass code
• Exact French location, date and time
• Every characteristic of the bike
steps.tip: Open your Velopass — your Velopass code is the identifiant unique the form asks for. All other bike details and the location are already in there.

steps.title: Receive your procès-verbal or book an appointment
steps.body:
**With FranceConnect:** you receive the official procès-verbal by email. Forward it to your insurer.

**Without FranceConnect:** pick a police station or gendarmerie near the theft location and book an appointment.

FR.chat_body: Already home and unable to finish the report fully online? Use the chat on [Ma Sécurité](https://www.masecurite.interieur.gouv.fr/).

DE.intro: In Germany you file the report online via the police's Onlinewache. Unlike Belgium or the Netherlands, each federal state (Bundesland) has its own Onlinewache — so you pick your state first.
DE.important_body: Not every state offers an online report for every type of offence, but bike theft can be reported online almost everywhere. A login is usually not required — you enter your details directly.

checklist.text: Brand, model, colour and bike type
Exact location, date and time of the theft
checklist.velopass: Already entered when you reported it in Velopass

steps.title: Go to the central Onlinewache
steps.body: [www.polizei.de](https://www.polizei.de/Polizei/DE/Einrichtungen/Onlinewache/onlinewache_node.html) → choose **'Onlinewache'**.

steps.title: Pick your federal state (Bundesland)
steps.body: Select the state where the bike was stolen. You'll be redirected to that state's Onlinewache.

steps.title: Start a report (Anzeige erstatten)
steps.body: Choose **'Diebstahl'** (theft) and then **'Fahrrad'** (bicycle) as the object.

steps.title: Fill in the form
steps.body:
• Personal details as the reporter
• Tatort: where and when was it stolen?
• Object: all bike details (Marke, Modell, Farbe, Rahmennummer)
steps.tip: Open your Velopass to have all bike details and the Rahmennummer at a glance.

steps.title: Review and submit
steps.body: Check the details and send. You'll receive a confirmation (Aktenzeichen / case number) from the police of the relevant state.

step3.title: Step 3 — Bike recovered? Report it!
step3.body: Congrats! Log in to your Velopass and mark your bike as **'Recovered'**. The status automatically changes back to ALL CLEAR. Then check that your Frame-ID is still intact — if not, order a new one via our webshop or at a Velopass bike shop.

cta.title: No Velopass yet?
cta.body: Register your bike now so every detail is always available — even when you no longer have your bike at hand.
